source: real camera on board 192.168.1.113 (SDI -> PL -> PS -> VPU), exposed through the board fragment API and re-published as HLS by a local read-only bridge.
boundary: HA runs on this workstation (the board only has Python 3.8). The bridge is a read-only client of the board: it opens no capture instance and never touches the SDK/DMA/VPU. Frame latency and browser smoothness not measured.
